entry_state: Seen from just behind and slightly above, the airplane glides along the right long side of the red track beside the row of white booth tents full of students, heading toward the school end.
beats: Continuing the reference video without any cut, at the same low height, the airplane glides on along the right long side of the red track beside the row of white booth tents full of students, toward the school end, gradually lowering to just above head height. The camera stays about two metres behind it.

Past the near-right corner of the track it keeps gliding in one wide, smooth leftward arc, never turning back sharply, passing well to the school side of the green air arch without touching or flying over it (the arch stays on its right, standing at the track gate): over the road in front of the arch and across the wide open lawn block, toward the WEST end of the food-truck lot. Behind the food-truck lot stands the school the airplane came from: a three-storey ivory-cream concrete school building with rows of windows, always the same building, never red brick.

Still turning gently left, it glides EASTWARD along the straight row of six colourful food trucks, a few metres above the students queuing in front of them and eating at the yellow parasol tables; the ivory school building stays in the background beyond the lot. There are NO bean bags anywhere near the food trucks or parasols. It does not fly toward the school building.

At the end of the truck row it crosses the straight road and curves gently left. The six food trucks stay parked exactly where they were with their tents and parasols; whenever the lot is in view all six trucks are still there, never an empty lot. It glides along the road past the vehicles parked in one line on that road, always the same: one dark truck, one white bus, one white box truck and one dark truck, never moving. Just beyond them, on the lawn between the road and the near-right curve of the track (track side of the road), students lounge on red, green and orange bean bags, seen only from above and behind.

From the bean bags it curves gently left along the track fence to the green inflatable air arch at the track gate and flies straight through the MIDDLE of the arch opening, below the top of the arch and well above the heads of anyone nearby; the camera passes through right behind it. This is the only time it meets the arch.

Inside the track it rises a little and glides clearly above the crossbar of the single near goal, then low across the grass pitch past the sound booth, above the heads of the many students sitting in the black chair blocks, heading straight for the stage.

Only now does it rise: the airplane climbs smoothly over the white truss roof of the stage and keeps climbing straight up into the deep blue sky; the camera tilts up following it, the frame fills with bright sunlight and glows to pure white.
exit_state: The frame is entirely bright white light.
audio: diegetic only: lively festival ambience (many voices chatting, gentle laughter, food-truck sizzle, footsteps), paper flutter, a rising airy breeze as the light grows.
extra_negatives: no high aerial drone view before the stage
no change of the festival layout
no air arch on the grass
no turning back to look at places already passed
no bean bags on the school side of the road
no flying over the top of the arch
no bean bags near the food trucks
